keyPoints: Aankde (data) ikatthe karke unhe ginne ke liye milan chihn (tally marks) lagate hain — har paanchven chihn ko tirchha kaat kar samooh banate hain.
Chitraalekh (pictograph) me tasveeron se sankhya dikhayi jaati hai — ek tasveer kitni ikai barabar hai, ye sanket (key) batata hai.
Dand-aalekh (bar graph) me barabar chaudai ke dande kheenche jaate hain — sabse lamba danda sabse badi sankhya dikhata hai, aur dandon ki lambai ka anupat sankhyaon ke anupat jaisa hota hai.
Dand-aalekh me akshon par sahi paimana (scale) chunna zaroori hai, jaise 1 ikai = 10 chhatra.
Aankdon ko dekh kar sawalon ke jawab milte hain — kis mahine sabse zyada barish hui, kaun sa khel sabse lokpriya hai, kis kaksha me sabse zyada chhatra hain.
Sahi nishkarsh ke liye poore aankde dekho, sirf ek dande se faisla mat karo.
Aam galti: dand-aalekh me dandon ke beech ki doori asaman rakhna ya paimana badal dena — isse tulna galat ho jaati hai.
subject: Maths
title: Aankdon ka Prabandhan
